reuse.why: Hooks the closed-account rule into the existing pre-link guard assertBankAccountNotLinked that every provider link function and linkBankSyncAccount already call, using the existing db.first helper.

duplication.why: A single new query and check; nothing is copied across the six provider paths.

placement.why: The guard layer before any bank/server work is the right place, but the closed check is folded into a function named for the duplicate-link rule, so the name no longer describes what it asserts.

scope.why: Twelve added lines in one function, nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Easy to own and covers all paths, though a reader looking for the closed-account rule would not expect it inside assertBankAccountNotLinked; a separate or renamed guard would be clearer.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the shared pre-link guard in accounts/app.ts that all link paths call.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by every link*Account function and by linkBankSyncAccount.
